name: tw-stock-etf-advisor
description: Taiwan ETF / stock research, buy-sell decisions, and personal holdings tracking. Finds common holdings between ETFs (e.g. 0050 / 0052), recommends what to buy and why with an entry/exit plan from a live quote, records the trades you make, and reviews your holdings to suggest what to sell. Always fetches live data via agent-browser; never guesses or derives prices.
